text: dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 为 DSH Web 提供 Obsidian wiki vault 工具：查询、写入、重命名、搭建、归档和健康检查。查询可读取热缓存或搜索页面并呈现链接关系；写入会维护 frontmatter、索引与日志；重命名会更新 wikilink。适合通过 DSH 管理本机跨项目知识库的用户。需将 vaultPath 配置为包含 wiki/ 和 .raw/ 的绝对路径。

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools adds query, write, rename, scaffold, archive, and lint tools for an Obsidian vault in DSH Web. Search returns snippets and link context; page writes maintain metadata, indexes, and logs. Set vaultPath to the absolute path of a vault containing wiki/ and .raw/.
想在 DSH 里搜索自己的 Obsidian 知识库页面。
帮我把整理好的内容写进 wiki，并自动补齐页面信息和目录记录。
我想重命名一篇 wiki 页面，同时更新指向它的内部链接。
有没有工具能检查知识库里的死链、孤立页面和过期索引？
I want to search my local wiki and get relevant page snippets with link context.
Help me initialize a structured wiki vault for a research project.
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 的功能「查询」：读取热缓存，或搜索 wiki 页面并返回匹配片段和页面链接关系。可选择 quick 或 standard 模式。
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 的功能「写入」：创建或更新页面，补全 frontmatter，并更新索引与日志；可追踪来源变化。
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 的功能「重命名」：修改页面标题，并更新 vault 中指向该页的 wikilink。
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 的功能「搭建」：按知识库用途创建目录、索引和种子页，保留已存在的文件。
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 的功能「检查」：扫描死链、孤立页和索引等问题，并写出检查报告。
想让 DSH 帮我维护知识库页面的索引和修改日志。
Can I check a wiki vault for broken links and stale index entries?

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供工具 wiki_query：Search the knowledge vault. Quick mode returns the hot cache and master index verbatim; standard mode runs full-text search over every wiki page and returns ranked matches with snippets, inbound links, and outbound link counts.
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供工具 wiki_write：Write or update one wiki page with full bookkeeping, frontmatter completion, uniqueness guard, index and log updates, and source hash delta tracking.
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供工具 wiki_rename：Rename one wiki page and rewrite every wikilink to it across the vault; aliases and heading anchors are preserved.
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供工具 wiki_scaffold：Scaffold a wiki vault in generic, sitemap, repository, business, personal, research, or book mode; existing files are kept.
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供工具 wiki_archive：Archive one cold raw source by moving it to .archive and dropping its manifest entry.

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools 提供工具 wiki_lint：Health-check the knowledge vault for duplicate filenames, dead wikilinks, orphan pages, frontmatter gaps, empty sections, stale index entries, and stale hot cache.

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · dsh-plugin-wiki-tools：Native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: `wiki_query`, `wiki_write`, and `wiki_lint` implement the mechanical core of the wiki skill suite — path routing, frontmatter completion, index/log bookkeeping, source delta tracking, and health checks — so the model spends its turns on synthesis instead of filesystem chores.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wiki-tools
```

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · dsh-plugin-wiki-tools：Pair with **[dsh-plugin-wiki-skills](https://github.com/Lion-1209/dsh-plugin-wiki-skills)** for the prompt-level skills (`wiki`, `wiki-ingest`, `wiki-query`, `wiki-lint`, `save`), and with **[dsh-wiki-web](https://github.com/Lion-1209/dsh-wiki-web)** for a self-hosted web UI over the same vault — browse, BM25 search, link graph, and lint dashboard in the browser, no Obsidian required.
dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · dsh-plugin-wiki-tools：*If this toolchain saves you time maintaining a wiki vault, a ⭐ helps other dsh users find it. 如果这个工具帮到了你，欢迎点个 Star。*

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · Attribution：The vault layout and operation contracts follow the LLM Wiki pattern (Andrej Karpathy) as embodied by [claude-obsidian](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian) (MIT, © 2026 AgriciDaniel). This package is an independent plain-ESM implementation of the mechanical core; it contains no code or skill text from claude-obsidian.

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `wiki_query` | Quick mode returns `hot.md` + `index.md` verbatim (the skill's read order); standard mode is full-text search over content pages with snippets and the inbound/outbound link graph |
| `wiki_write` | Writes one page with complete bookkeeping: type→folder routing, frontmatter completion (keeps `created` and unknown fields on update), filename-uniqueness guard, master-index entry, log entry; with `source_path`, records the source hash and skips unchanged sources unless `force` |
| `wiki_lint` | Health check: duplicate filenames, dead wikilinks, orphan pages, frontmatter gaps, empty sections, stale index entries, stale hot cache — report only, with suggestions, written to `wiki/meta/Lint Report <date>.md` |

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · Install and configure：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wiki-tools
```

`vaultPath` is **required**. The boot fails loud until you set it from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: wiki-tools
  config:
    vaultPath: /absolute/path/to/vault
    # optional: reroute page types to your vault's folders; index section

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · Install and configure：The vault is the directory holding `wiki/` and `.raw/` — scaffold it first with the `wiki` skill's SCAFFOLD operation. `maxQueryResults` (default 10) is optional. `wiki_write` refreshes existing index entries in the section's own style (`: ` or ` — `), so em-dash vaults stay consistent.

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · Design notes：- The vault is host-local user data outside any session workspace (cross-project referencing is the point), so the tools read and write through `node:fs` against the explicitly configured absolute root — not a dsh filesystem seam.
- Writes serialize per target file in-process; filenames are guarded unique vault-wide because wikilinks resolve by bare name.
- Registers on `ctx.tools` via `defineTool`; schemas stay stable regardless of vault contents.

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · Develop：```sh
npm install
node --test
```

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · 出处：vault 布局与操作契约遵循 LLM Wiki 模式（Karpathy），形态来自 claude-obsidian（AgriciDaniel，MIT）。本包为独立的纯 ESM 实现，不含 claude-obsidian 的代码或技能文本。

dsh-plugin-wiki-tools README · 安装与配置：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wiki-tools
```

`vaultPath` 为必填项：在你的 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `wiki-tools` 行的 config 指向 vault 根目录（含 `wiki/` 与 `.raw/`，先用 wiki 技能的 SCAFFOLD 操作搭建），否则启动时会明确报错并给出示例。
